transformer.original.name: Original photo
transformer.original.description: The source image without any transformations.
transformer.black_white.name: Black and white (2 colors)
transformer.black_white.description: Hard brightness threshold: every pixel becomes either black or white.
transformer.black_white.var.threshold.de: Pixels brighter than this value become white, the rest become black. The higher the value, the darker the result.
transformer.afterimage.name: Negative afterimage
transformer.afterimage.description: Stare at the red dot in the center for 20-30 seconds without moving your eyes, then look at a white wall or a blank sheet of paper: you will see the original image in normal colors.
transformer.afterimage.var.dot_size.name: Dot size
transformer.afterimage.var.dot_size.desc: Radius of the red fixation dot in per mille (‰) of the image's shorter side.
transformer.afterimage_positive.name: Positive afterimage (with eyes closed)
transformer.afterimage_positive.descript: Darken the room, set the screen brightness to maximum and stare at the dot in the center for 20-30 seconds without moving your eyes. Then close your eyes and cover them with your palms: the image will stay visible for a few seconds. Stop if you feel any discomfort.
transformer.afterimage_positive.var.satu: Color saturation boost. 100 % means no change. Bright saturated colors produce a more noticeable afterimage.
transformer.afterimage_positive.var.clip: The share of the darkest and brightest pixels ignored when stretching contrast. The higher the value, the more contrasty the result.
transformer.afterimage_positive.var.dot_: Radius of the gaze fixation dot in per mille (‰) of the image's shorter side.
transformer.dither_floyd_steinberg.name: Floyd-Steinberg dithering
transformer.dither_floyd_steinberg.descr: Only black and white, but the quantization error is spread over neighboring pixels, so the eye “sees” smooth halftones.
transformer.dither_floyd_steinberg.var.t: Brightness from which a pixel becomes white. The higher the value, the darker the result.
transformer.dither_floyd_steinberg.var.d: The share of the quantization error passed to neighboring pixels. 100 % is classic dithering, lower values give a more contrasty, “harder” image.
transformer.dither_bayer.name: Bayer dithering (ordered)
transformer.dither_bayer.description: Ordered dithering: brightness is compared with a repeating threshold matrix. The result is a characteristic regular “mesh” texture in which halftones are visible too.
transformer.dither_bayer.var.matrix_expo: Threshold matrix size: 1 = 2x2, 2 = 4x4, 3 = 8x8, 4 = 16x16. Small matrices give a coarse regular pattern, large ones give smoother halftones.
transformer.dither_bayer.var.bias.name: Threshold shift
transformer.dither_bayer.var.bias.descri: A positive value makes the result darker, a negative one makes it lighter.
transformer.halftone.name: Halftone
transformer.halftone.description: The image is made of black dots of different sizes on a tilted grid (like in newspapers). From a distance the dots merge into halftones.
transformer.halftone.var.dots_across.des: How many halftone dots fit along the shorter side of the image. Fewer dots mean a coarser screen and a rougher picture.
transformer.halftone.var.grid_angle.name: Grid angle, °
transformer.halftone.var.grid_angle.desc: Tilt angle of the dot grid. 45° is the classic newspaper screen, 0° means the grid is parallel to the edges.
transformer.lincoln.name: Lincoln effect (pixelation)
transformer.lincoln.description: Coarse pixelation. Up close the image is unreadable, but if you step back, shrink the window or squint, the picture suddenly emerges.
transformer.lincoln.var.blocks_on_long_s: How many large “pixels” fit along the longer side of the image. The smaller the value, the larger the blocks and the stronger the effect.
transformer.hermann_grid.name: Hermann grid
transformer.hermann_grid.description: A darkened image with a white grid. Ghostly dark spots appear at the intersections of the white lines where you are not looking directly.
transformer.hermann_grid.var.cells_acros: How many grid cells fit along the shorter side of the image.
transformer.hermann_grid.var.line_width_: Width of the white grid lines as a percentage of the cell size.
transformer.hermann_grid.var.background_: How much the image under the grid is darkened. The darker the background, the more distinct the ghost spots at the intersections.
transformer.cafe_wall.name: Café wall
transformer.cafe_wall.description: Rows of light and dark tiles shifted relative to each other, with gray mortar lines. Although all the lines are strictly horizontal, they appear to be tilted.
transformer.cafe_wall.var.tiles_across.d: How many rows of tiles fit along the shorter side of the image.
transformer.cafe_wall.var.contrast_perce: How strongly the dark and light tiles cover the original image. The higher the value, the more distinct the illusion, but the harder it is to see the picture.
transformer.cafe_wall.var.row_shift_perc: By how much (as a percentage of the tile size) every second row is shifted. The tilted-lines illusion is strongest at a shift of about 25-50 %.
transformer.autokinetic.name: Autokinetic illusion
transformer.autokinetic.description: Parallel lines that taper to a point at the edges of dark shapes. The edges of the shapes may seem to pulsate or spread. Works best on high-contrast silhouettes; the effect varies from person to person.
transformer.autokinetic.var.lines_across: How many parallel lines fit along the shorter side of the image. More lines mean a finer, more detailed pattern.
transformer.autokinetic.var.lines_direct: 1 - horizontal lines, 2 - vertical lines. The tips at the edges of shapes always point along the lines, so the direction changes the look of the illusion.
How many times the darkness map is blurred. The higher the value, the smoother and longer the tips at the edges of shapes.
transformer.autokinetic.var.clip_percent: The share of the darkest and brightest pixels ignored when stretching contrast. The higher the value, the more contrasty the result.
transformer.pencil_sketch.name: Pencil sketch
transformer.pencil_sketch.description: The image turns into a pencil drawing: outlines and shadows are drawn with thin strokes on white paper.
transformer.pencil_sketch.var.tip_size.d: Thickness of the pencil strokes in pixels. The larger the value, the thicker and softer the lines.
transformer.pencil_sketch.var.color_rang: How dark the drawing is. Positive values make shadows richer, negative values make the drawing lighter, leaving mostly outlines.
transformer.oil_painting.name: Oil painting
transformer.oil_painting.description: The image turns into an oil painting: neighboring pixels are merged into brush strokes of a single color.
Stroke radius in pixels. The larger the value, the bigger the strokes and the fewer the details.
How many brightness levels are distinguished when choosing the stroke color. A lower value gives flatter, “cartoonish” colors, a higher one gives smoother transitions.
transformer.peripheral_drift.name: Peripheral drift
transformer.peripheral_drift.description: Concentric rings of alternating light and dark segments. The static pattern may be perceived as rotating in peripheral vision or during small eye movements.
transformer.peripheral_drift.var.rings_a: Number of concentric rings. More rings mean a finer, denser pattern.
transformer.peripheral_drift.var.segment: Number of radial segments in each ring. A larger value creates a finer pattern.
transformer.peripheral_drift.var.pattern: How strongly the pattern is blended with the original image. At 100 % the original photo is completely replaced by the pattern.
dialog.select_audio.title: Select a music file
music.title: Music mode
music.status.initial: Select a music file and press Play.
music.status.ready: Analysis done. Choose dependencies and press Play.
music.volume.tooltip: Playback volume (logarithmic scale). Does not affect sound analysis or the image.
music.fps.tooltip: How many times per second the image is updated. Higher is smoother but heavier on the CPU.
music.position.tooltip: Track position. You can seek during playback.
transformer.bokeh_blur.name: Bokeh soft focus
transformer.bokeh_blur.description: Softens the image and adds translucent circular highlights sampled from bright areas, creating a bokeh-like lens effect.
transformer.bokeh_blur.var.blur_radius.d: Radius of the blur applied to the whole image. Larger values produce a softer, less detailed background.
transformer.bokeh_blur.var.cell_size.des: Distance between candidate highlight centers. Smaller values create more circles; larger values make the effect sparser.
transformer.bokeh_blur.var.highlight_thr: Only source areas brighter than this value create bokeh circles.
transformer.bokeh_blur.var.highlight_str: How strongly the sampled bright colors are blended into the circular highlights.
transformer.motion_blur.name: Motion blur
transformer.motion_blur.description: Averages pixels along a chosen direction, simulating camera or subject movement during exposure.
transformer.motion_blur.var.distance.des: Length of the motion trail in pixels. Larger values create a longer streak.
transformer.motion_blur.var.angle.name: Direction, °
transformer.motion_blur.var.angle.descri: Direction of the simulated movement: 0° is horizontal to the right, 90° is downward.
transformer.motion_blur.var.samples.name: Sample count
transformer.motion_blur.var.samples.desc: Number of samples along the motion trail. More samples make the blur smoother but require more processing.
transformer.motion_blur.var.strength.des: Blend between the original image and the motion-blurred result.
transformer.surface_blur.name: Surface blur
transformer.surface_blur.description: Smooths texture while preserving strong edges: pixels with similar brightness contribute more to the average.
transformer.surface_blur.var.radius.name: Neighborhood radius, px
transformer.surface_blur.var.radius.desc: Size of the area considered around each pixel. Larger values smooth broader details.
transformer.surface_blur.var.edge_thresh: Controls how readily colors across an edge are mixed. Lower values preserve edges more strongly.
transformer.surface_blur.var.strength.de: Blend between the original image and the smoothed result.
transformer.surface_blur.var.spatial_wei: Controls how quickly the influence of distant pixels decreases within the neighborhood.
transformer.sketch_blur.name: Soft sketch
transformer.sketch_blur.description: Creates a soft monochrome pencil/charcoal look by combining blurred tones with darkened edges.
Radius used to soften the grayscale image before extracting edges.
transformer.sketch_blur.var.edge_strengt: How strongly detected edges are drawn as dark pencil strokes.
transformer.sketch_blur.var.contrast.des: Controls tonal separation between light paper and dark image areas.
transformer.sketch_blur.var.paper_bright: Brightness of the paper background. Higher values make the sketch lighter.
